title: repo-audit page-extra.json
description: What the main session writes for the report page, beside findings.json (SKILL.md Stage 6): the prose, plan, fleet-standards rows, extra tables, screenshots, mockups and research that findings.json does not hold. render.py builds the page from the two files and template.html. Every string typed `prose` is trusted inline HTML (render.py allows only text, link, list, table and inline-SVG tags and their plain attributes, links to #, relative paths, http, https and mailto, and no url() or literal colour in a style or colour attribute); `text` strings are plain and escaped. The checker implements the keywords findings_check.py does: $ref to $defs, type, enum, pattern, required, properties, items and additionalProperties false. Counts and non-empty rules beyond that are render.py's.

intros.description: One intro per section. `plan`, `standards`, `rules` and `coverage` are required. `measurements`, `screens`, `mockups` and `research` keep their section and are required with its data. `since` is required when findings.json has `diff: null`, else appended to the computed counts. An area key keeps that area's section (it has one anyway when it has findings, fleet-standards fails aside) and is required for each section the page shows; a Not-assessed area has none.

plan.description: Now / Next / Later. Every Blocker in findings.json `scorecard.blockers` is in `now`. `finding` is an id on the page: a finding id, `fs-<standard id>` or a section id such as `research`.

standards.description: The Fleet standards table, one row per checklist row, n/a rows included. `rows` is empty when the checklist could not be read, the repo is not a fleet repo or has no remote; `intros.standards` then says why. A `fail` row, and a report-only `FLAG` row, carry `severity`. `label` is only for a report-only row: `OK` with `pass`, `FLAG` with `unchecked`.

tables.description: Extra evidence tables, each under the section it belongs to: `rules`, `measurements`, or an area section (`external-facts`, `agent-readiness`, `repo-hygiene`), where it sits before the finding table. A table with more than four columns is rendered wide. Cells are prose.

screens.description: Captures, already downscaled (JPEG about q70). `path` is a file, relative to this file's folder; render.py embeds it as a data: URI. Empty or absent deletes the Screens section; method_note then reads `No captures: <reason>`.

mockups.description: At most three, only when the design lens reported a High or Blocker finding. `html` replaces the contents of the mockup frame and uses only --mk-* colours. `width` is the frame's width in px plus 56. Empty or absent deletes the section; screens intro or method_note then reads `No mockups: <reason>`.

research.description: The market lens's output as sources. Absent deletes the Research section.

checked.description: What Stage 4 verified, corrected, merged, disputed and could not verify, one line each. The section is deleted when every list is empty.

since_notes.description: A note for one key of findings.json `diff`, for example both severities of a still-open item. Without one, a key in this run links to its finding, a not-re-checked key gives its area's reason, and a not-re-raised key a stock sentence.
